findings.evidence: Roadmap Layer 3 item 1 says “Under μ-a.e. measurability of all distance sections … prove basepoint-independence,” while `wassersteinEDist_dirac_left_le_add` and every downstream moment theorem take `hd : Measurable fun z : X × X ↦ edist z.1 z.2`.
findings.fix: Restate the one-sided Dirac and finite-moment lemmas using measurability (or measure-specific a.e. strong measurability) of the relevant sections, and prove basepoint independence from those section hypotheses; retain joint measurability only for symmetry and other genuinely two-variable results.
findings.issue: The Dirac/basepoint results require joint measurability `hd`; this unnecessarily excludes spaces where every distance section is measurable, precisely the regime required for finite-moment basepoint independence. The same restriction occurs at lines 252, 288, 319, 328, 338, and 346.

summary: The finite-moment and Dirac API is restricted to jointly measurable ground distance, missing the roadmap’s required section-measurable regime.
